family.description: This is the conserved leucine-rich domain (LRD) within the C-terminal domain of SPIN90 (also known as NCK interacting protein with SH3 domain (NCKIPSD)) from animals, Ldb17 from budding yeasts and Dip1 from fission yeasts [[cite:PUB00098231]]. Ldb17 is involved in the regulation of endocytosis in yeast [[cite:PUB00054166]]. SPIN90 is an F-actin binding protein that regulates actin polymerization and endocytosis [[cite:PUB00085468]]. It associates with and activates the Arp2/3 complex, without requiring a preformed actin filament [[cite:PUB00054166],[cite:PUB00033588],[cite:PUB00054167]]. This LRD, within the C-terminal armadillo repeat (ARM) domain of SPIN90, is important for activation of Arp2/3 complex [[cite:PUB00098231]].
family.name: SPIN90/Ldb17, leucine-rich domain
